sentences.text: This blue shark carried its tag for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}: {species_rank_days}.
Blue sharks are found in oceans worldwide and are known for long migrations.
Its positions range from {southernmost_lat} to {northernmost_lat}, and on {farthest_date} it was {max_displacement_km} from where its track began.
Its daily positions add up to {path_km}.
